business_rules.name: Calculate Regular Pay
business_rules.description: Calculates regular pay for hours worked up to 40 hours per week
business_rules.purpose: Compute base compensation for standard work hours
business_rules.logic: Multiply hours worked (up to 40) by the hourly rate to determine regular pay amount

business_rules.name: Calculate Overtime Pay
business_rules.description: Calculates overtime pay at 1.5x rate for hours exceeding 40 per week
business_rules.purpose: Compute premium compensation for overtime hours
business_rules.logic: If hours worked exceed 40, calculate overtime hours (total - 40) and multiply by hourly rate times 1.5

business_rules.name: Validate Hours Worked
business_rules.description: Ensures hours worked is within acceptable range
business_rules.purpose: Prevent invalid time entries from being processed
business_rules.logic: Check if hours worked is between 0 and 80. Set validation flag to 'Y' if valid, 'N' if invalid

business_rules.name: Apply Tax Withholding
business_rules.description: Calculates federal tax withholding based on gross pay and tax bracket
business_rules.purpose: Determine federal tax amount to withhold from employee pay
business_rules.logic: Apply tax percentage based on bracket: 10% for bracket 1, 15% for bracket 2, 22% for bracket 3, 24% for bracket 4

business_rules.name: Calculate Health Insurance Deduction
business_rules.description: Deducts health insurance premium if employee is enrolled
business_rules.purpose: Apply health insurance cost to employee paycheck
business_rules.logic: If insurance flag is 'Y', apply deduction: $150 for individual, $350 for family plan

business_rules.name: Calculate 401k Contribution
business_rules.description: Calculates employee 401k contribution based on percentage
business_rules.purpose: Determine retirement savings deduction from paycheck
business_rules.logic: Multiply gross pay by contribution percentage (0-15%) to calculate 401k deduction

business_rules.name: Calculate Net Pay
business_rules.description: Computes final net pay after all deductions
business_rules.purpose: Determine actual amount to be paid to employee
business_rules.logic: Subtract all deductions (tax, insurance, 401k) from gross pay to calculate net pay
conditions: All deduction amounts must be valid

business_rules.name: Check Minimum Wage Compliance
business_rules.description: Ensures hourly rate meets federal minimum wage requirement
business_rules.purpose: Validate compliance with minimum wage laws
business_rules.logic: Compare hourly rate against federal minimum wage ($7.25). Set compliance flag to 'Y' if compliant, 'N' if not

business_rules.name: Accumulate Year-to-Date Totals
business_rules.description: Updates cumulative year-to-date pay and deduction totals
business_rules.purpose: Maintain running totals for tax reporting and employee records
business_rules.logic: Add current period amounts to year-to-date totals for gross pay and tax withholding

business_rules.name: Format Pay Stub Output
business_rules.description: Formats all pay information for printing on pay stub
business_rules.purpose: Present payroll information in readable format for employee
business_rules.logic: Format all pay components with proper decimal places, currency symbols, and alignment for printing
conditions: All numeric values formatted to 2 decimal places

data_mappings.transformation: Convert binary register value to packed decimal format (COMP-3)
Convert binary register value to decimal currency format with 2 decimal places
Convert binary percentage value to decimal (0.00-0.15)
Convert calculated binary value to packed decimal currency format
Convert final calculated value to packed decimal currency format
Extract 6-digit employee ID from memory location and format as alphanumeric
Extract 30-character employee name from memory and trim trailing spaces
validation_rules: Must contain at least one alphabetic character

data_mappings.transformation: Accumulate year-to-date gross pay in packed decimal format

summary:
Business Rules Extraction Summary:
- Total Business Rules: 10
- Total Data Mappings: 10
- Key Rules: Calculate Regular Pay, Calculate Overtime Pay, Validate Hours Worked

This payroll program implements comprehensive employee compensation logic including:
- Regular and overtime pay calculation
- Tax withholding based on brackets
- Health insurance deductions
- 401k retirement contributions
- Minimum wage compliance validation
- Year-to-date accumulation
- Pay stub formatting

The program processes employee time and rate information, applies all applicable deductions,
and produces formatted pay stubs with detailed breakdowns of earnings and withholdings.
